### Findings (1)

**prose** (1)
- `backlog/3240-verify-has-no-gate-input-so-it-cannot-replace-the-call-sites.md` — The backlog item is marked `status: resolved` but its own 'Done when' section still reads the scaffold placeholder 'TODO: a command that fails before this item lands and passes after' rather than naming the actual verifying test. — A reader auditing resolved backlog items for their executable proof would find no concrete command/test named here, even though `verify.test.mjs` clearly supplies one — purely a documentation completeness gap, not a behavior defect. _[impact if unfixed: cosmetic]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ A lint/check that flags a backlog item transitioning to `status: resolved` while its Done-when section still contains the literal string 'TODO'.

---

**Decision:** `accept` — recorded by operator.
**Lens:** `correctness` — a SINGLE-LENS run. One `judge` step, one juror, one lens; the table above lists only the lens that judged. The other 3 panel lenses (security, simplicity, standards-conformance) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
Net basis: `19e67126d7ac13e5c11820f2b088ae6363b05b5c..ea102c7606b314b3f5fc60a25ac662492be0320c` (rev `origin/lane/verify-gate-input` at review time) — 7 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.
